package paragraph

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// FlowTiming contains invocation-local E3 phase durations. Freeze includes
// materialization, line-local bidi ordering and allocation. Assembly includes
// metrics, atomic placement and validated publication. Failed calls are not samples.
type FlowTiming struct {
	Bind, Break, Freeze, Assembly time.Duration
}

type flowTimingKey struct{}

// FlowTimingContext enables phase clocks only in the experimental overlay.
// The caller owns timing and serializes every operation using it.
func FlowTimingContext(ctx context.Context, timing *FlowTiming) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, flowTimingKey{}, timing)
}

func flowClock(ctx context.Context) time.Time {
	if t, _ := ctx.Value(flowTimingKey{}).(*FlowTiming); t != nil {
		return time.Now()
	}
	return time.Time{}
}

func flowRecord(ctx context.Context, start time.Time, phase string) {
	if start.IsZero() {
		return
	}
	d := time.Since(start)
	t := ctx.Value(flowTimingKey{}).(*FlowTiming)
	switch phase {
	case "bind":
		t.Bind += d
	case "break":
		t.Break += d
	case "freeze":
		t.Freeze += d
	case "assembly":
		t.Assembly += d
	}
}
